finding.text: A task's full title can't be read anywhere at 400 (Requirements 2, "a simple overview of all the tasks"; layout: wrapping): all 8 visible rows end in "…" ("Owner back 11-09: decide the 10 open …"), and opening a row shows why, outcome and evidence but never repeats the title (`page.js` `task_detail`). shots/…/400.png, Tasks band. Fix: put `t.title` as the first line of `task_detail`, or let the summary wrap once it is open.

`probe.mjs` only works in the qf-3 worktree, so a fresh agent can't re-make the shots from this folder. It imports `file:///C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/qf-3/Server/Browser.mjs` and loads `http://qf-3.localhost/`. The task's closing log still says "re-run probe.mjs to regenerate". Fix: import `Server/Browser.mjs` by a path relative to the repo, and take the host from an argument.

The page's own shots aren't committed, though the brief's Proof asked for them. The minion logged why (`**/shots/` is gitignored, `.gitignore:213`), but because of finding 2 the regenerate route it offers is broken too. The review shots in `shots/127-0-0-1-55336-live-session/` cover 400 and 1200 for now; say so on the task.

There is no session title (Requirements 1, "a title"; page 1). The h1 says only "Session". The file holds no title (`index.json` title = the id), so the page could say "Voice session · Nov 6" instead. Cost isn't shown because `index.json` has `usd: 0`, which matches "cost if the file has it".

On wide screens the header card fills the whole width with three short lines (layout/sizing). `wide` stretches it to about 1800 px at 3440 (`layout.json` empty 0.779 at 3440, 0.658 at 1200). shots/…/3440.png, band 2.
At 400 the "Tasks" and "Child sessions" h2s sit about 7 px under the card above them, much tighter than their gap to what follows (spacing). shots/…/400.png, the band at y≈245–260.

The "Waiting on you" group is hidden when it's empty, because `draw` skips groups with no tasks. Showing "Waiting on you (0)" would tell the owner nothing is waiting on them, instead of leaving them unsure.
Every page load logs a 404 (`layout.json` errors, all four widths). The minion says it's the long-standing `page-work.json` warning that also shows on /framework/, so it isn't caused by this diff.
